items.title: Giraffe with Sydney Skyline
items.caption: Shot at Taronga Zoo. The giraffe enclosure frames the harbour, Opera House and CBD skyline across the water.
items.captionZh: 摄于塔龙加动物园。长颈鹿展区框住海湾，对岸是悉尼歌剧院与城市天际线。

items.title: Yeni Camii at Golden Horn Dusk
items.titleZh: 金角湾暮色 · 耶尼清真寺
items.caption: Viewed from Galata Bridge, the boundary between old and new Istanbul. Ramadan mahya lights stretch between the minarets of Yeni Camii.
items.captionZh: 摄于加拉塔大桥，伊斯坦布尔老城与新城的分界。耶尼清真寺的宣礼塔之间，斋月麦哈亚灯缓缓亮起。
